packageRules.description: Hold TypeScript at 6.x. TypeScript 7.0 is the Go-native compiler and shipped without a stable programmatic API, so typescript-eslint, ts-api-utils and @swc-node/register cannot run on it - Nx fails to build its project graph, which takes lint, test and build down together. Angular's compiler-cli independently requires typescript >=6.0 <6.1, so no TypeScript version satisfies both Angular 22 and a v7 bump. 6.x is deliberately still allowed: it is the actual upgrade path to Angular 22. Revisit when typescript-eslint and @swc-node/register ship v7 support and Angular's compiler-cli accepts it.
Batch JavaScript dependencies managed through npm, pnpm, or Yarn
Batch dependencies published from the Sneat-Co GitHub organization
Own libraries are never gated: the fleet must be on the latest sneat-co release always (founder rule 2026-09-02). Third parties keep the weekly window and the 1-day release age above.
Auto-merge dependency updates once checks pass.
